taste:
This pizza combines a crisp base with soft vegetable toppings and a creamy, savoury cheese alternative. Rich tomato sauce sits underneath the peppers, courgettes and onions, so the flavour is built around tomato and roasted vegetables rather than meat. Sweet roasted peppers provide the clearest sweet note, while the tender courgettes contrast with the texture of the base.

Served fresh and hot, it is described as having a melting topping rather than a dry cheese substitute. The creamy finish complements the vegetables' natural sweetness, giving you a useful guide to the overall balance: crisp underneath, softer on top, with savoury and sweet flavours together.
